tasks.title: Define Monthly Logo Retention
tasks.context: Leadership needs a retention KPI for existing customers.
tasks.prompt: Which formula should the dashboard use?
tasks.expectedAnswer: Starting customers still active at month end divided by customers active at month start
tasks.explanation: Retention follows the starting customer cohort rather than mixing in newly acquired customers.
options: Starting customers still active at month end divided by customers active at month start
All month-end customers divided by all historical leads
